quote: The argument here rests on beneficence and compassion: if we can safely relieve suffering, refusing to do so is itself a moral failure.  Surveys in Australia and comparable countries consistently find majority support for therapeutic uses of gene technologies, with support falling sharply for enhancement and for heritable changes.  Options for this assembly range from maintaining the prohibition, through moratoria with built-in review, to licensed pathways for defined serious conditions under strict conditions.
